# Pop Smiles

> > Pop Smiles is a family-friendly pediatric dentistry and orthodontics practice in Pennington, NJ, offering comprehensive dental care for children, teens, and adults under the direction of Dr. Meryl Baurmash.

Pop Smiles specializes in pediatric dentistry and orthodontic treatment, including traditional braces, ceramic braces, Invisalign, two-phase orthodontic treatment, and specialized services like sleep apnea treatment and airway expansion (MARPE). The practice is conveniently located in Pennington, New Jersey and accepts major insurance plans.

- [About Orthodontics](https://www.popsmiles.com/about-orthodontics): Overview of orthodontics treatment process and benefits at Pop Smiles
- [Orthodontic Services](https://www.popsmiles.com/orthodontic-services): Orthodontic services including metal braces, ceramic braces, and Invisalign
- [Orthodontics For All Ages](https://www.popsmiles.com/orthodontics-for-all-ages): Orthodontic treatment for children, teens, and adults at Pop Smiles
- [Two-Phase Orthodontic Treatment](https://www.popsmiles.com/two-phase-treatment): Two-phase orthodontic treatment combining tooth straightening and facial development
- [Sleep Apnea & Airway Expansion](https://www.popsmiles.com/SleepApnea): Sleep apnea and airway expansion treatment including MARPE at Pop Smiles
- [Fluoride Treatment](https://www.popsmiles.com/fluoride-treatment): Fluoride treatment for cavity prevention and teeth strengthening at Pop Smiles
